about.description: WTI Crude Oil (CL futures) perpetual on Variational Omni (Arbitrum), USDC-margined RFQ perpetual quoted by the single Omni Liquidity Provider (OLP), which aggregates pricing from CEXs/DEXs/AMMs/OTC venues. Tracks the NYMEX WTI Crude Oil front-month contract price, with up to 50x leverage, with zero trading fees, with OLP capturing spread, cash-settled in USDC on Arbitrum, permissionless access, self-custody margin. Positions sit in an isolated onchain escrow with pre-defined margin and liquidation rules.
